deliverable_a.name: De-restriction sweep
deliverable_a.classification_rule: An agent-invented rule is presumed removable and the burden is on the rule to name the defect it caught. FOUNDER_BOUND requires a founder source; EARNED_CONTROL requires a defect reproduced in this estate; ASSISTANT_IMPOSED requires the locator where it was introduced and a re-inheritance probe.

roles_in_one_line.CURSOR: Execution and acceptance platform of record. Unit of dispatch is an agent group, not one agent.
roles_in_one_line.CHATGPT: Discovery, integration and authority capture. Reassigned off evidence review, which used none of its asymmetry.
roles_in_one_line.GITHUB: Custody, plus a second execution domain and an unused event substrate.
roles_in_one_line.SW: Paused. Planned as a high-fanout producer under acceptance it does not control, never a coordinator.
roles_in_one_line.OPEN_LOCAL_MODELS: The substitutability proof behind an adapter boundary, and the second cognition domain for platform-level claims.

mechanisms_shipped.does: Verifies the register's evidence discipline and scans live routing surfaces for removed restrictions still in force. Negation-aware.
Enforces 14 invariants: single-holder decision classes, founder-reserved classes, acceptance independence, runtime-is-not-authority, required substitution route.
Mutates both registers to trigger 20 named failure modes (NR1-NR9, NL1-NL5, ND1-ND6) and asserts each is caught.
Builds and re-checks the delivery manifest with namespace closure and material claim-input closure.

open_findings_for_the_holder_of_other_pa.why_this_lane_did_not_fix_them: All three lie outside this lane's write scope, and two are under state/** or commissions/** where a write from this lineage would silently set currentness for every inheriting branch (EC-13). Reporting with exact locators is the correct action; applying the change is the path holder's.
open_findings_for_the_holder_of_other_pa.detector: python3 tools/derestrictctl.py scan  (exits 1 until these are resolved)

self_reported_defect.what: The first version of derestrictctl.py scan flagged five re-inheritances. Two were supersession statements: sentences whose purpose is to remove the restriction.
self_reported_defect.why_it_mattered: A detector that reads a removal as a re-imposition would tell a future lane to strip the very sentences doing the de-restricting, which is the opposite of this lane's purpose.
self_reported_defect.fix: Negation awareness: a window around each match is checked for supersession markers, and the classes are reported separately as RE_INHERITED and SUPERSESSION_STATEMENT.

correction_made_before_commit.what: Both registers claimed five distinct exact model configurations across the nine top-level cloud agents. Re-running the inventory returns four.
correction_made_before_commit.resolution: Corrected to four. The fifth configuration, gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh, is real but sits below the top level as the L3 acceptor, so it is recorded separately rather than claimed from that listing.
correction_made_before_commit.why: EC-14 disallows evidence that overstates what was reached. A count is evidence.
